purpose: The Azion brand logo, rendered as an inline SVG lockup. A single `variant` prop selects the lockup: `default` (the AZION wordmark) for standard surfaces, `reduced` (the "A" glyph) for compact headers and tight spaces, and `extended` (the AZION wordmark with the "move to the edge technologies®" tagline) for marketing-oriented layouts. It consolidates the loose `@aziontech/webkit/svg/azion/*` assets — which remain individually importable — behind one component.
useWhen: Use Brand only for the Azion logo.
The Azion logo in a header, navigation bar, footer, sign-in screen or product mockup.
`variant="reduced"` where space is tight (collapsed sidebar, mobile header).
`variant="extended"` in marketing layouts that carry the tagline.
avoidWhen: A customer or partner logo → use `logo-wall`.
A person's or organization's picture → use `avatar`.
related: `site-header-section` and `site-footer-section` — compose Brand for the site chrome.
`avatar` — the picture or initials of a user, not the product mark.
bestPractices: Choose the lockup with `variant` and the height with `size` (16 / 24 / 32 px); do not pass width or height classes, the width follows the lockup's aspect ratio.
Do not recolor or rebuild the SVG; use the component so every surface shows the same mark.
For a home link, wrap Brand in an anchor; its `role="img"` and accessible name "Azion" give the link its name.
Take the logo only from Brand, never from a copied SVG file or a website URL.
Keep clear contrast between the logo and its background, and clear space around it; never shrink it below the `small` size.
Do not set the logo next to text or interface elements in the brand primary colour: the signature lockup already carries it.
Black and white versions of the logo do not exist yet: ask the Design team for them, never recolour a copy.
